question: What doctrinal obligation of concealment is placed on one who is firmly resolved with regard to this extracted teaching?
premises: This extracted teaching is the object in question.
It is to be concealed always.
This obligation falls on one who is firmly resolved.
inference: One who is firmly resolved is doctrinally obliged to conceal this extracted teaching at all times.
uncertainties: The reason for the obligation of concealment is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: This extracted teaching is to be concealed always by one who is firmly resolved.
